Autopilot Autopilot combines a forward looking camera, radar, and 360 degree sonar
sensors with real time traffic updates to automatically drive Model S on the open
road and in dense stop and go traffic. Changing lanes becomes as simple as a tap
of the turn signal. When you arrive at your destination, Model S will both detect
a parking spot and automatically park itself. Standard equipment safety features
are constantly monitoring stop signs, traffic signals and pedestrians, as well as for
unintentional lane changes.
